faq.question: Do you do installation or only supply materials?
faq.answer: We provide both! We supply quality natural stones directly from our quarry and yards, and our experienced master stone masons carry out complete on-site installation, grouting, and stone sealant finishing.

faq.question: Can you bring stone samples to my construction site?
faq.answer: Yes! Our project consultant visits your construction site anywhere in Greater Kampala or Wakiso with our physical stone sample box so you can see and feel the textures against your walls before deciding.

faq.question: How do you calculate the price for my project?
faq.answer: We price per square meter (m²) for wall cladding and compound pavers. Once our technician takes laser measurements of your wall area or you share your architectural elevations, we provide a free itemized quotation.

faq.question: Do you deliver stones outside Kampala?
faq.answer: Yes, we supply and install stones countrywide across Uganda (Entebbe, Jinja, Mbarara, Masaka, Gulu, Fort Portal, Mbale, etc.). Transportation is arranged directly to your site.

faq.question: Do you work with contractors, builders, and architects?
faq.answer: Yes! We run a dedicated B2B Trade Partner program offering discounted bulk rates and a 10% referral commission for building contractors, site foremen, architects, and interior designers.
